description: Image Description: The image shows a resting cow lying on a bed of straw inside a barn or livestock facility. It is positioned on its side, with its legs folded neatly beneath its body and its head slightly raised. The cow's eyes are open, and it appears calm and relaxed. A yellow ear tag with the number "107" and a green tag are visible on its left
